Definition: of Latin origin; "fortunate"; Fortunatus, a Christian:--Fortunatus.
BiblicalUsage: Fortunatus is a Christian of Corinth whose name means fortunate, and Paul is glad when he arrives. He says he is glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus, for what was lacking on the Corinthians' part they have supplied.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Fortunatus is the fortunate one in the plainest sense: his coming supplied what was lacking, and Paul's gladness is the whole of his story.
